summary_1line: A philosophical discourse explains the causal chain from soul to action and teaches that realizing the attributeless Brahman/Vishnu leads to liberation.

image_candidates.scene_text: A lone yogi sits in deep meditation while the vast cosmos fades into a formless light symbolizing the attributeless Brahman.
The sun spreads radiant rays over the world and then withdraws them at sunset, symbolizing the shift between attributes and the attributeless.
A storm-driven ship on a dark sea is finally guided by the wind into a calm harbor, symbolizing the soul reaching its final refuge.
